# Hunter Walk

## Self-Aware Self-Promotion

# About

Current: Partner at Homebrew. Seed stage venture capital serving founders. Brewed in SF. Enjoyed nationwide. Find us at Homebrew.co. Also backing new venture firms via Screendoor, a new type of LP. [...] Previously: Led consumer product management at YouTube, delivering billions of playbacks a day across computers, phones, tablets and TVs. Joined Google in 2003 managing product and sales efforts for Google’s contextual advertising business. Founding member of the product and marketing team at Linden Lab, the creators of online virtual world Second Life. Earlier, a management consultant and also spent a year at Late Night with Conan O’ Brien, broadcasting to an audience of insomniacs, truckers [...] truckers and college students. Grinded a BA in History from Vassar and an MBA from Stanford University.
